description: Get a single discussion topic in a group by ID, returning its title, message, posted_at, discussion_type, published state, and is_announcement, plus due/available dates via Canvas's all_dates include. Find topic_id with list_group_discussions. Group-scoped only — use get_discussion for a topic that belongs to a course instead of a group; there is no group-scoped counterpart to post_discussion_entry, so this server cannot post a reply to a group topic yet.
name: get_group_discussion
title: Get Group Discussion
